macros.name: animaBoardDimension
macros.doc: \animaBoardDimension{⟨w⟩}{⟨h⟩} With the command \animaBoardDimension{⟨w⟩}{⟨h⟩}, it is possible to modify the dimensions of the presentation.

macros.name: animaColor
macros.doc: This command internally uses the \animaColorTheme command to provide color palette options for slide presentations using the anima class.

macros.name: animaColorTheme
macros.doc: \animaColorTheme{⟨c1⟩}...{⟨c6⟩} The command \animaColorTheme{⟨c1⟩}...{⟨c6⟩} defines the color palette for the slide presentation.

macros.name: animaFormatText
macros.doc: The command \animaFormatText{⟨conf⟩} is used to modify the formatting of the block titles.

macros.name: animaFormatTitle
macros.doc: The command \animaFormatTitle{⟨conf⟩} is used to modify the formatting of the block content texts.

macros.name: animaFrameTitle
macros.doc: The command \animaFrameTitle{⟨t⟩}{⟨n⟩}{⟨c⟩}{⟨y⟩} can be used to create a title slide for the presentation.

macros.name: animaStyle
macros.doc: This command provides style options for slide presentations using the anima class.

macros.name: animaTheme
macros.doc: This command provides theme options for slide presentations using the anima class.

macros.name: nFrame
macros.doc: The command \nFrame is the counter that indicates which frame of the animation is currently being displayed.

macros.name: uns
macros.doc: This command is a function that divides the interval [0, 1] into three parts proportional to the ratio a:b:c and performs the animation in the intermediate part.

envs.name: frame
envs.doc: Like the beamer class, the anima class uses the frame environment to create slide presentations.
